name: CSN Jumpstart Concurrent Enrollment
what_you_do: Take a college class at your own high school. A high school teacher approved by CSN teaches it. You earn college credit at a lower price.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 at a high school that works with CSN on Jumpstart. You need a 2.5 GPA on a 4.0 scale. CSN may make exceptions with your school district.
pay_detail: $110 per course for the 2026 to 2027 school year, paid to your high school. Textbooks are free from your high school.
duration: One course at a time, during the school year
deadline_text: Apply no later than two weeks before the start of the semester.
how_to_apply: Fill out the CSN Admissions Application for High School and Early College Programs. There is no application fee. CSN emails you an NSHE ID. English and math classes also need a placement test or ACT or SAT scores.
notes: Partners include Clark County School District, charter schools and private schools in the Las Vegas area. Ask your counselor which Jumpstart classes your school offers.
